rationale: The editor data plane (host parameter surfaces, value sources, value channels and their telemetry and JSON projection) moves from core/view into the UI-free Pulp module core/dataplane. The sources leave core/view; the pulp/view headers become forwarding headers that re-export the pulp::dataplane names into pulp::view, and view.hpp, scripted_ui.hpp and design_param_binding.hpp take their forward declarations from <pulp/dataplane/fwd.hpp>. Vellum does not take this: the next re-export drops these units from the set, and Vellum's widgets bind to its own generic value model.
